name: single arm overhead dumbbell squat
description: Squat while holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm. It builds leg strength and demands good shoulder and trunk control.
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and keep it locked out.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your ribs down and the weight over your shoulder.
Drive up to standing, then switch arms after your reps.
